organization_name.rationale: Organization name is a header-level field stored in the common return header, not as a leaf element within IRS990ScheduleJ.

ein.rationale: EIN is a header-level field stored in the common return header, not as a leaf element within IRS990ScheduleJ.

tax_year.rationale: Tax year is a header-level field stored in the common return header, not as a leaf element within IRS990ScheduleJ.

first_class_or_charter_travel.rationale: Matches Part I line 1a directly to FirstClassOrCharterTravelInd.

travel_for_companions.rationale: Matches Part I line 1b directly to TravelForCompanionsInd.

tax_indemnification_or_gross_up.rationale: Matches Part I line 1c (tax indemnification/gross-up) to IdemnificationGrossUpPmtsInd.

discretionary_spending_account.rationale: Matches Part I line 1d directly to DiscretionarySpendingAcctInd.

housing_allowance_or_residence.rationale: Matches Part I line 1e directly to HousingAllowanceOrResidenceInd.

payments_for_personal_use_of_housing.rationale: Matches Part I line 1f directly to PaymentsForUseOfResidenceInd.

health_or_social_club_dues.rationale: Matches Part I line 1g (health or social club dues) to ClubDuesOrFeesInd.

personal_services.rationale: Matches Part I line 1h directly to PersonalServicesInd.

written_compensation_policy.rationale: Matches Part I line 2 (written policy for T&E expenses) to WrittenPolicyRefTAndEExpnssInd.

compensation_approved_by_independent_com.rationale: Matches Part I line 3 checkbox (i) for independent compensation committee review to CompensationCommitteeInd.

compensation_approved_by_full_board.rationale: Matches Part I line 3 checkbox (ii) for full board or independent board committee approval to BoardOrCommitteeApprovalInd.

compensation_approved_by_officer.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to officer-approved compensation (Part I line 3 checkbox iii); the canonical schema does not expose this checkbox as a separate indicator.

comparability_data_used.rationale: Matches Part I line 3 comparability data sub-question to CompensationSurveyInd.

contemporaneous_documentation.rationale: Matches Part I line 3 documentation sub-question to RebuttablePresumptionProcInd, which captures the rebuttable presumption procedural requirement including contemporaneous documentation.

severance_payments.rationale: Matches Part I line 4a directly to SeverancePaymentInd.

supplemental_nonqualified_plans.rationale: Matches Part I line 4b directly to SupplementalNonqualRtrPlanInd.

equity_based_compensation.rationale: Matches Part I line 4c directly to EquityBasedCompArrngmInd.

compensation_based_on_revenues.rationale: Matches Part I line 5a (compensation based on revenues of filing org) to CompBasedOnRevenueOfFlngOrgInd; note separate elements exist for related orgs (idx 6).

compensation_based_on_net_earnings.rationale: Matches Part I line 5b (compensation based on net earnings of filing org) to CompBsdNetEarnsFlngOrgInd; note separate elements exist for related orgs (idx 5).

nonqualified_deferred_compensation_plans.rationale: No candidate element directly maps to Part I line 6 (nonqualified deferred compensation / IRC 409A); the canonical schema does not expose this as a standalone indicator.

former_employee_compensation_over_150k.rationale: Matches Part I line 7 (compensation reported on other organizations' Form 990) to Form990OfOtherOrganizationsInd, which is the closest available indicator for prior/former employee compensation reporting.

loans_to_covered_persons.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to Part I line 8 (loans to covered persons); the canonical schema does not expose this as a standalone indicator within IRS990ScheduleJ.

compensation_table.rationale: The blueprint bundles the entire Part II repeating table into one array field; the canonical schema splits this into the RltdOrgOfficerTrstKeyEmplGrp repeating group (idx 20) with many child elements (idx 21–38) — blueprint should be refactored into individual sub-fields matching each child element of the group.

supplemental_information.rationale: Matches Part III free-form narrative to ExplanationTxt within SupplementalInformationDetail; blueprint bundles the full text but canonical schema splits it into FormAndLineReferenceDesc + ExplanationTxt pairs — blueprint should be refactored to reflect this repeating group structure.
